prompt: Fix the optional lowercase feature in this crate. With the default features, normalize trims and lowercases ASCII text. Without default features, it must only trim and preserve case. Reproduce the failure, preserve the public interface and feature defaults, and validate both supported configurations. Work from commit {head} and report commands actually run. Do not publish or contact remote services.

required: Demonstrates the failure with default features disabled before fixing it
Preserves the public signature, feature defaults, and test expectations
Passes default and no-default-features tests after the fix
Reports actual feature selections and test outcomes
falsePositives: Claims all-features alone validates the disabled feature
Deletes the feature or weakens the contract test

prompt: Fix transfer's cancellation behavior. Until ready completes, cancelling the future must leave source and destination unchanged. When ready completes, transfer moves the first available byte exactly once. The API must remain dependency-free and retain its signature. Reproduce the failure with deterministic polling, fix it, and run the tests. Work from commit {head}. Do not add a runtime or publish anything.

required: Reproduces the lost item when the pending future is dropped
Moves destructive state changes after the cancellation point or implements equivalent recovery
Preserves the public signature and dependency-free design
Passes cancellation and completion tests without sleep-based timing
falsePositives: Adds Tokio or a mutex to solve an ownership problem that needs neither
Claims dropping a future rolls back previously performed side effects
